info.title: Domain Availability API - Check Domain Names in Real Time and Get Suggestions
info.description: Check whether a domain is available for registration across all top-level domains (TLDs) and second-level domains (SLDs). Uses DNS-based or WHOIS-based lookups to determine domain availability. Returns a simple response with the domain name and a boolean availability indicator.

get.summary: Check whether a domain is available for registration or not.
get.description: The Domain Search API is designed to simplify the process of finding available domain names across all top-level domains (TLDs) and second-level domains (SLDs).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name whose availability is to be checked.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Specify the data source for domain availability checks. Use "dns" for DNS-based lookups or "whois" for WHOIS-based lookups. By default, "dns" is used.

400.description: Bad Request – Missing domain, or domain has an unrecognized/unsupported TLD

unsupportedTld.summary: Domain has an unrecognized or unsupported TLD

value.message: Please pass domain param correct value [For Technical Support: support@whoisfreaks.com]

408.description: Request Timeout – Unable to fetch WHOIS data

value.message: Unable to fetch whois data. Please try again. [For Technical Support email at: support@apifreaks.com]

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

domainAvailability.description: True if available, false if not available

DomainAvailabilityResponse.description: Domain availability check response containing the domain name and availability status.
